faqs.q: How do I apply for a company or partnership contractor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a company or partnership contractor licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: What can I do with my existing licence?
faqs.a: You can renew, change conditions, add work categories, change contact details, change the name, replace, restore, or surrender your licence.

faqs.q: How do I change the name on my licence?
faqs.a: You can change the name on your licence using the dedicated transaction page.
